Values 0<alpha<1 combine group-level L2 with coordinate-level L1 shrinkage.
alpha=1 removes the group term. Overlapping groups are rejected.
Penalties apply to eligible SEM parameter coordinates, not graph nodes.
The Core synthetic workflow is in basic-cfa.Rmd.
